text:
incident-bot: Paging: HIGH - model fetch failures (huggingface) affecting cold-starts across hosted clusters. Alert rule: hf.fetch.error_rate > 15% over 2m. Root TS: 1998123456

maya (oncall): I’m on it. Seeing repeated 429s and occasional 503s when pulling artifacts. Cold starts failing to download model files, causing timeouts on initial requests.

samir (runtime): Logs show retry storms. Example: `Failed to fetch model: HTTP 429` then immediate retry -> another 429. We’re hitting HF rate-limits and our retry jitter is too aggressive.

kevin (infra): Confirmed at infra side: egress to s3-like endpoints for HF hosted artifacts is saturated in eu-west. But endpoints are returning 429 rate-limit before network issues. Link: https://status.huggingface.co (hf-status-bot posted updated incident).

hf-status-bot: Hugging Face: "We are seeing elevated rate limits for model downloads in eu-west-1, working on mitigation." https://status.huggingface.co/incidents/abcdef

maya (oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) enable local gateway caching/mirror for most-requested models 2) fall back to smaller quantized variant we already have in cache 3) route new customers to dedicated warm pool if available 4) throttle retries and increase backoff. Which can we do fast?

samir (runtime): Quick wins: a) cap retries to 2 with exponential backoff + random jitter b) serve from KV cache for prefix hits c) for models with known fallbacks, return a 200 from local proxy pointing to cached smaller model. I can push a runtime patch to change retry config in ~8 mins.

kevin (infra): I can flip caching mirror for eu-west edge and enable prefetch for the top 5 heavy models (takes ~10 mins to seed). Need list of model ids.

julie (support): We’ve received 6 customer-reported incidents so far (enterprise and self-serve). Notifying accounts on higher SLAs: AcmeCorp, FinanceCo. Drafting a short status message: "We’re experiencing downstream artifact hosting rate-limits that may cause elevated latencies and failed cold starts. We are actively mitigating and will update in 30m."

rosa (product): Prioritize minimizing customer impact on chat flows. Fallbacks are acceptable for cold starts as long as we notify and track regressed quality. Also create an eval-run for the fallback variants.

maya (oncall): Action plan: 1) samir deploy runtime retry config (cap=2, backoff base=800ms, jitter up to 1.2x) - ETA 8m 2) kevin enable mirror for top-5 models - ETA 12m 3) julie send initial customer advisory - ETA 10m 4) samir add temporary model fallback mapping for premium tenants - ETA 15m 5) escalate to HF support if no improvement in 20m.

samir (runtime): Pushing config now. Command: ```kubectl set env deployment/runtime RETRY_CAP=2 RETRY_BASE_MS=800 RETRY_JITTER=1.2 --namespace=prod```

incident-bot: Deploy started by samir at 1998123510. CI job: runtime-retry-config-1998123510.

kevin (infra): Starting mirror seed job for models: `big-llama-7b`, `redwood/bison-2`, `open/text-40B`, `tpl/mini-13b`, `fastchat/opt-6.7b` (placeholder names). Kicking off: `mirror-seed --region eu-west-1 --models-file /tmp/top5.txt`

samir (runtime): Runtime config applied to 80% of pods in prod. Observability: request failure rate dropped from 18% -> 9% on those pods within 90s.

kevin (infra): Mirror seed initial status: 40% of chunks downloaded for `big-llama-7b`. Mirror proxy returning 200 for files already seeded.

julie (support): Sent advisory to affected customers and posted in #status-updates. Copy: "We are experiencing downstream model artifact hosting rate-limits from a third-party provider which may impact cold starts. We're applying retries/backoff and local caching; we will follow up with timeline and mitigation details."

maya (oncall): Good. Monitoring dashboard: requests failing due to fetch errors reduced cluster-wide to 6% after both mitigations (mirror + retry). Cold start error rate dropped but still occasional spikes ~30s windows.

rosa (product): Need to log every fallback so we can run qualitative evals. Create tag `fallback:hf-rate-limit-1998123456` on requests served with fallback model. Also notify evals team.

samir (runtime): Will add header `X-Fallback-Model: small-quantized-v1` for responses served from fallback and emit metric `fallback.served{reason=hf_rate_limit}`.

kevin (infra): HF status updated: they are implementing rate-limit relief; ETA unknown. I am opening a ticket with HF support and requesting bulk mirror allowance for our infra.

maya (oncall): Next steps: 1) keep mirror seeding until all top5 are cached 2) maintain reduced retry policy for 60m 3) collect a sample of 200 fallback responses and send to evals 4) create post-incident doc with timeline and cost impact estimate.

julie (support): Logged all customer contacts to the incident ticket. Will schedule proactive outreach to enterprise customers if any degrade further.

incident-bot: Pager status: acknowledged by maya. Severity: high -> monitoring. Notifications throttled to on-call channels.

maya (oncall): I’ll continue to monitor for 30 mins and then hand off to kevin at 1998123756 if stable. If degradation returns, we escalate to HF support and consider switching routing policy to dedicated reserved capacity for affected tenants.

kevin (infra): Acknowledged. I’ll be on standby for handoff.

samir (runtime): Quick note: once mirror finishes, we should consider permanent pre-warm policy for top X models to avoid future cold-start pain.

julie (support): Will prepare an external postmortem blurb and a timeline of customer impacts.

maya (oncall): Handoff planned at 1998123756 to kevin (infra). Closing out immediate page rotation but keeping this thread open for follow-ups and the postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
